messages.author: 681b1f85f070a606
messages.subject: sort bar graph
parts:
Hi,

In the website, at the geom_bar page, there's an example of almost exactly what I need: 
> # A bar chart used to display means 
> meanprice <- tapply(diamonds$price, diamonds$cut, mean) 
> cut <- factor(levels(diamonds$cut), levels = levels(diamonds$cut)) 
>qplot(cut, meanprice, geom="bar", stat="identity")
The only missing info I need is how to sort the bars from least to most. 
Can you please help me with that?
Thanks,
Oshrat.

messages.author: 2710b717e5dbb066
messages.subject: Re: sort bar graph
parts:
R sees the ordering of levels in a factor as a property of the data
rather than a property of the graph/analysis, so you don't change the
plot, you change the factor and the plot should take care of itself.
You can do this by hand when you create the factor by the order that
you specify the levels argument or you can use a function like
'reorder' to do it automatically based on a second variable. For your
case, using reorder on the 'cut' factor will probably be the simplest.

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: sort bar graph
parts:
The reorder() function will reorder the levels of a factor based on
some other vector. This should do what you want:

qplot(reorder(cut, meanprice), meanprice, geom="bar", stat="identity")

-Winston
